## `createApiKey`

Create an API key

The full `api_key` appears only once in the creation response. The client is responsible for storing it.

| Property        | Value                                                                    |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| HTTP            | `POST` `/v1/api-keys`                                                    |
| SDK method      | `device.createApiKey(request, execution?)`                               |
| SDK return type | `Promise<ApiResult<OperationData<DeviceApiOperations["createApiKey"]>>>` |
| Authentication  | `X-Api-Key` (injected by the client)                                     |
| Mutability      | `write`                                                                  |
| Automatic retry | No automatic retries                                                     |

### Parameters

No path, query, header, or cookie parameters.

### Request body

JSON request body.

| Field         | Required | Type     | Constraints | Description                                  |
| ------------- | -------- | -------- | ----------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `body.name`   | Yes      | `string` | -           | -                                            |
| `body.prefix` | No       | `string` | -           | The prefix used when generating the API key. |

### Responses

| HTTP status | Content-Type       | Schema                  | Description                                                                                                |
| ----------- | ------------------ | ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `201`       | `application/json` | `ResponseMeta & object` | Created successfully. Returns the one-time plaintext API key and key metadata that may be displayed later. |
| `400`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The request body or parameters are invalid.                                                                |
| `401`       | `application/json` | `ErrorEnvelope`         | The API key is missing or cannot be validated.                                                             |

The SDK returns `ApiResult<T>` with `data`, `status`, an optional `requestId`, and the underlying `response`.

Success status `201` response fields:

| Field                             | Present | Type                                  | Constraints               | Description                                                                          |
| --------------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------- | ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `result.data.request_id`          | No      | `string`                              | -                         | The request ID generated by the server.                                              |
| `result.data.client_request_id`   | No      | `string`                              | -                         | Echoed when the client supplies a valid `X-Request-Id` request header.               |
| `result.data.data`                | Yes     | `APIKeyCreateResult`                  | -                         | -                                                                                    |
| `result.data.data.key`            | Yes     | `APIKey`                              | -                         | -                                                                                    |
| `result.data.data.key.id`         | Yes     | `string`                              | -                         | -                                                                                    |

| `result.data.data.key.key_prefix` | Yes     | `string`                              | -                         | A display-safe key prefix, not the full API key.                                     |
| `result.data.data.key.status`     | Yes     | `string enum("active" \| "inactive")` | enum="active", "inactive" | -                                                                                    |
